documents.text: The median is the middle value after sorting observations. It resists extreme outliers. For 1, 2, 100 the median is 2.
The arithmetic mean is the sum divided by the number of observations. Extreme outliers can shift the mean strongly. For 1, 2, 100 the mean is 103/3.
Variation describes the spread of observations. Variance is the average squared distance from the mean in a population. Standard deviation is the square root of variance.
Linear interpolation estimates a short gap in an ordered time series from neighboring values. Check that the gap is short and the series changes smoothly.
In Python, a class groups behavior and state. Its __init__ method initializes an existing instance. The self parameter refers to that instance.
In Python, __new__ creates an instance before __init__ initializes it. These are distinct responsibilities.
The median strip of a road separates opposite traffic. It does not define a statistic.
